# Meals, salads and snacks
[color=#B7ABA0]THE WASTELAND TABLE / CHAPTER 07[/color]
## Dumplings
[bold]Ingredients:[/bold] 3 x dough slice + 10u water + 6u uncooked animal proteins.
[bold]Cook:[/bold] 15 seconds.
## Bowl of hot chili
[bold]Ingredients:[/bold] 1 x bowl + 1 x wild glowpepper + 1 x raw rad cutlet + 1 x red onion slice + 1 x wild tato.
[bold]Cook:[/bold] 20 seconds.
## Queso
[bold]Ingredients:[/bold] 1 x wild glowpepper + 2 x cheese wedge + 5u black pepper.
[bold]Cook:[/bold] 15 seconds.
## Bbq ribs
[bold]Ingredients:[/bold] 2 x raw bighorner steak + 1 x skewer + 5u BBQ sauce.
[bold]Cook:[/bold] 15 seconds.
## Enchiladas
[bold]Ingredients:[/bold] 1 x raw gecko meat + 2 x wild glowpepper + 1 x wild maize.
[bold]Cook:[/bold] 20 seconds.
## Herb salad
[bold]Ingredients:[/bold] 1 x bowl + 3 x wild broc flower + 1 x wild mutfruit.
[bold]Cook:[/bold] 5 seconds.
## Coleslaw
[bold]Ingredients:[/bold] 1 x bowl + 1 x wild onion + 1 x wild cabbage + 5u vinaigrette.
[bold]Cook:[/bold] 5 seconds.
## Caesar salad
[bold]Ingredients:[/bold] 1 x bowl + 1 x red onion slice + 1 x bread slice + 1 x cheese wedge + 1 x wild cabbage + 5u olive oil.
[bold]Cook:[/bold] 5 seconds.
## Meat kebab
[bold]Ingredients:[/bold] 3 x raw rad cutlet + 1 x skewer.
[bold]Cook:[/bold] 5 seconds.
## Soft taco
[bold]Ingredients:[/bold] 1 x dough slice + 1 x wild tato + 2 x red onion slice + 1 x cheese wedge + 1 x raw rad cutlet.
[bold]Cook:[/bold] 10 seconds.
## Stick of cannabis butter
[bold]Ingredients:[/bold] 1 x stick of butter + 6 x cannabis leaves.
[bold]Cook:[/bold] 15 seconds.
## Corn in butter
[bold]Ingredients:[/bold] 1 x wild maize + 1 x large plate + 1 x stick of butter.
[bold]Cook:[/bold] 10 seconds.
